name: track_monitoring_devices_on_service_trains
description: Synthetic Category contract case (RC-68): an operator puts track-monitoring cameras and lasers on a service train to inspect track condition in operation.

candidates.title: Metro puts track-monitoring devices on a service train
candidates.search_snippet: The operator showed a service train fitted with devices that inspect the track while it runs.
candidates.source_content: The metro operator showed a service train fitted with under-floor cameras and lasers that measure track deformation and damage to track equipment while the train runs in normal service. The data will be used to follow track deterioration and to decide maintenance timing from the measured condition instead of fixed patrol intervals. The train starts using the devices at the end of the month.

contract_notes: Category follows the supported principal action in substantive source content.
Search intent, source title, technical novelty, taxonomy, and Reportability are not Category authorities.

RC-68: putting a monitoring technology into use is a deployment under TECHNICAL_DEVELOPMENT even when it changes how inspection and maintenance are done; it is not a change to how the passenger service is operated (RC-63, G101). This case locks Category only.
